verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is indirect, community-sourced: npm automatically runs packages' postinstall scripts when the install event occurs, which is an npm-owned mechanism for running actions on an event. Nothing documents a general way for users to define rules that trigger actions on events. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of lifecycle scripts or hooks, user-defined event rules beyond install-time scripts, a range of supported trigger events, and hands-on corroboration framed as a feature rather than a security risk.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
